title: Each type as a Pakistani drama archetype
caption:
If your life were a Pakistani drama, which character would you be?

The quiet elder sibling who saw it coming in episode 2. The lead staring at the rain while the OST plays. The comic relief who secretly carries the whole show. Every type has its role, and you already know yours.

Tag the friend who would definitely get the rooftop monologue.

Which character are you?
